_meta.notes: Country water-risk scores from WRI Aqueduct 4.0 via the World Bank Data360 mirror (WRI's own S3/GitHub CSVs are permanently offline). Three indicators, 0-5 scale, SCORE rows only — RANK and RISK_CAT share the same value column and are excluded. Coverage: water_stress 164, drought_risk 138, flood_risk 164 countries. Aggregation weight is total water withdrawal where published, population-weighted for riverine flood (the only weight it carries). Baseline reflects 1979-2019 hydrology — structural, not current-season. Coastal flood and water depletion remain absent from this mirror.
